source: Loom's status record, maintained in the repository and checked against main

items.label: b10x-loom run
items.detail: Routes an intent to a protocol, opens a governed case and runs it until it is blocked, printing each step and the stop reason. Exit 0 at the human gate, 3 for another stop. Completed a live run against a hosted model on 2026-10-05.

items.label: b10x-loom-sdk
items.detail: One crate that re-exports Commission's contracts and runtime, the executor, the governor and intake. Its example runs a whole embedding on scripted fake models.

items.label: Source releases at version tags
items.detail: 0.2.0 is the current release (0.1.0 was the first): a bare-version tag the release workflow verifies against the workspace version and CHANGELOG.md, with a GitHub Release. Consumers pin tag = "0.2.0".

items.label: A release on a registry
items.detail: Nothing is on a registry; consumers depend on a release tag.

items.label: Commission's runtime loop
items.detail: run_until_blocked drives a commission over its ports until the run stops: approval gate, nothing performable, authority needed, step budget, or 64 steps without a budget.

items.label: Revalidation before every effect
items.detail: Each proposal becomes an action request bound to the frontier's revision and is rechecked against the current frontier, case revision and authority provider.

items.label: Commission makes the effect call
items.detail: Admitted requests go to the embedder's EffectPort once; the case moves only after a Performed effect (Atlas ADR 0082).

items.label: Connector and Substrate effect ports
items.detail: General Connector bindings are planned. The local adapter embeds Substrate for tests.

items.label: Commission's contracts stay independent
items.detail: b10x-loom-commission depends on no Loom executor, no Canon and no model-provider crate; task commission:deps-guard fails the gate if it does.

items.label: Loom implements Commission's AgentExecutor
items.detail: A step projects the frontier, selects over that catalogue, asks Commission's admission check, generates arguments and ends at a ProposedAction. Loom invokes nothing and never suspends for authority.

items.label: Loom revalidates its selection before proposing
items.detail: With Loom::with_governor, a step reads the case's current frontier from the governor once after the selection and proposes nothing for a selection made at another case revision or of an action that frontier's catalogue does not list. Under Commission's run_until_blocked, a case that moves between Commission reading its frontier and Loom's revalidation (while the selector selects or while arguments are generated) is judged on the frontier it left, so a run can end with no admissible action for a case that completed, or ask for evidence the moved case no longer needs, until the executor port can report a moved case to Commission. Opt-in: b10x-loom run does not enable it yet.

items.label: Selections outside the catalogue are refused
items.detail: The catalogue lists only actions Commission admission does not refuse. An action id it does not list is refused whatever its confidence, and no arguments are generated.

items.label: Model-backed selector and argument generator
items.detail: The slice's ModelSelector and ModelArguments, each one forced tool call through llm, told the intent, its references and a bounded transcript.

items.label: Arguments for the selected action only
items.detail: A generator is handed the selected catalogue entry only, and the request for arguments is recorded against its selection.

items.label: Schema validation of arguments
items.detail: Where an action schema comes from is not decided.

items.label: Fast typed and hybrid selectors; confidence fallback; selection telemetry
Canon governor
items.detail: CanonGovernor evaluates a case's engineering protocol with Canon on every frontier and completion; no clock, network or model call, and no invented authority.

items.label: Hosted governor contracts
items.detail: Implemented on the development branch: host-admitted Canon protocols, trusted freshness callback and fallible case storage. No database backend or automatic protocol adoption.

items.label: Intent references
items.detail: Tracker keys, chat permalinks, merge and pull requests and URLs, extracted in order without a model.

items.label: Protocol router
items.detail: A model picks one protocol of the engineering protocol registry; a pick outside it or below the threshold is refused.

items.label: Local slice for software-change@1
items.detail: Edits, inspects and tests a git work tree; evidence only from the test command's exit status; never merges, pushes or deploys. Tests use Substrate by default in current source.

items.label: Executors for other protocols
items.detail: An incident-response slice is on the plan. Today any pick other than software-change@1 stops with NoLocalExecutor.

items.label: Run model generated from ESS
items.detail: Session, Turn, ActionCatalogue, Selection and ArgumentRequest are synthesized from ess/ and re-exported; Commission's model likewise from ess/commission/.

items.label: ESS hard gate
items.detail: task check fails unless loom and commission validate strictly, compile, synthesize with no refusals and carry no open question; intake's system validates.

items.label: Commission's ESS conformance suite
items.detail: b10x-loom-commission passes the suite synthesized from ess/commission/.

items.label: Harness modules ported
items.detail: The provider wires, messages, responses, HTTP and the turn loop of Harness, as modules of b10x-loom-executor. JSON from a model or provider nested deeper than 128 levels is refused with a typed error.

items.label: Sessions, transcripts and streaming
items.detail: The session module runs the ported loop and files its session outside the workspace (directory 0700, file 0600), up to its last completed turn, with no credential and no instruction text; a filed session is resumed by id. Streamed deltas reach the sink as they arrive. Not yet called from a governed run.

items.label: Harness loop wired to a governed run
items.detail: Loom::run_loop, and LoopExecutor behind Commission's AgentExecutor port, run the ported loop on one frontier: each turn's tool list is the catalogue projected from the governor's current frontier, a model's call of a catalogue action is selected, given its arguments and revalidated before Loom proposes it, a call outside the catalogue is refused to the model by name, and each completed turn is recorded. Each compaction of the run's session is recorded with the usage the endpoint reported for its summary request; the request after it keeps the standing instruction and carries the current frontier's catalogue. Still planned: budgets, and interruption and recovery (a run that proposed is not resumed once Commission has acted). b10x-loom run does not use it yet.
